title: micranthemum reflexum
intro: Micranthemum reflexum, commonly known as the 'Purple Sour Grapes' or 'Purple Creeping Thyme', is a type of flowering plant in the mint family (Lamiaceae). It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Micranthemum reflexum include soothing digestive issues and promoting relaxation due to its calming effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
